<!--
  Navigation between product categories as chips, a bar with an underline, a side list, tiles with a big icon,
  or chips under a toolbar (search, sort and the number shown). The current one carries aria-current. Axes:
  layout (chips, bar, sidebar, tiles, toolbar), count (show, hide), icon (show, hide), density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Category, CategoryTools } from "./category-nav.types";

export type CategoryNavProps = {
  label: string;
  categories: Category[];
  current?: string;
  layout?: "chips" | "bar" | "sidebar" | "tiles" | "toolbar";
  count?: "show" | "hide";
  icon?: "show" | "hide";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  tools?: CategoryTools;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Select from "../primitives/select/select.vue";
import SelectOption from "../primitives/select/select-option.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SearchField from "../components/search-field.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  categories,
  current = "all",
  layout = "chips",
  count = "show",
  icon = "show",
  density = "default",
  tools,
} = defineProps<CategoryNavProps>();
const chipLike = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "chips") || ((layout as string) === "toolbar"));
const tiles = computed(() => (layout as string) === "tiles");
const linkShape = computed(() =>
  chipLike.value ? "inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded px-3 py-1.5 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
  : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "inline-flex items-center gap-2 -mb-px border-b px-1 py-2"
  : tiles.value ? "flex h-full flex-col items-start gap-4 rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
  : "inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded px-3 py-2"
);
const currentLook = computed(() =>
  chipLike.value ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
  : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "border-foreground font-semibold"
  : tiles.value ? "inset-ring-foreground font-semibold"
  : "bg-muted font-semibold"
);
const otherLook = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "bar") ? "border-transparent" : "");
const listShape = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "sidebar" ? "flex flex-col gap-2"
  : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "flex flex-wrap gap-2 gap-x-4 border-b border-border"
  : tiles.value ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6"
  : "flex flex-wrap gap-2"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Container
    :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-2' : 'py-4'))"
    data-slot="container"
  >
    <Block tag="nav" :aria-label="label" data-testid="category-nav" :data-layout="layout">
      <Group
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'toolbar')"
        gap="4"
        align="center"
        class="mb-4 flex-wrap"
        data-testid="toolbar"
      >
        <SearchField :value="(tools?.query ?? '')" :label="(tools?.search ?? '')" :placeholder="tools?.search" />
        <Select name="sort" size="sm" :aria-label="tools?.sort" class="w-48">
          <SelectOption value="sort" :label="tools?.sortValue" :selected="true" />
        </Select>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tools?.shown }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <List tag="ul" :class="listShape" data-testid="items">
        <ListItem v-for="c in categories" :key="c.id">
          <Link
            href="#/categories"
            variant="default"
            :aria-current="((c.id === current) ? 'page' : undefined)"
            :class="cn('text-sm', linkShape, ((c.id === current) ? currentLook : otherLook))"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <template v-if="((icon as string) === 'show')">
              <Inline v-if="tiles" class="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
                <LucideIcon :name="c.icon" :size="20" />
              </Inline>
              <LucideIcon v-else :name="c.icon" :size="16" />
            </template>
            <Inline>
              {{ c.name }}
            </Inline>
            <Text v-if="((count as string) === 'show')" size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ (c.count == null ? undefined : String(c.count)) }}
            </Text>
          </Link>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </Block>
  </Container>
</template>
